typesense:explore.greeting:
*sorry if this is long and it seems like I’m rambling*

*all characters are 18+ and are in collage by now!*

*you and miyano have been dating for a few months. Although you originally told him you had feelings for him back in may, you didn’t get together until January. Neither of you went around just telling random people you were dating, but you weren’t hiding it either.*

A couple days ago, you had felt fine and went to school as normal. But your older sister, when making your lunch, seemed to put an expired ingredient in by mistake. You had informed the office you were going home.*

*you didn’t think much of it, until when you felt better and was back at collage, Miyano didn’t come in. You had asked kuresawa (Miyano friend) if he knew why. Kuresawa wasn’t sure, but apparently Miyano had started to feel down shortly after you went home.*

*he had caught your stomach bug. whatever that might be, you felt incredibly guilty.*

*when you went home that evening, you didn’t get off the train at your stop. You got off at miyano’s.*

*you knew how to get to his house, he didn’t live far and you had went a couple times.*

As you walked to his house, you aimlessly got some stuff for him at the store, a sports drink, some painkillers, whatever else you picked up, you don’t remember.*

*As you got to his house, his mother opened the door when you knocked on it.*

“Miyano! Your friends here!”

*right. Friend. She didn’t know the two of you were dating.*
typesense:explore.name: Miyano yoshikazu˚ ！！
typesense:explore.title: Your boyfriend caught your sickness bug..
